strings.story_spielplatz.title: The Playground at the Forest's Edge
strings.story_spielplatz.opening.caption: At the edge of the forest stands an old playground. Beyond it, a mountain range stretches to the horizon.
strings.story_spielplatz.talk_to_juan.caption: Juan would like to play with the other children.
strings.story_spielplatz.path_repaired.caption: The children build a smooth path together. Now everyone can reach the playground.
strings.story_spielplatz.waited.caption: The children make a plan and gather what they need first.
strings.location.lichtwald_spielplatz.name: Forest-edge playground
strings.resource.holz.name: Wood
strings.resource.lichttropfen.name: Light Drops
strings.recipe.make_lichttropfen.name: Make Light Drops
strings.npc.juan.name: Juan
strings.conversation.juan_playground.wish.text: I'd like to play too. The entrance is too bumpy for my wheelchair.
strings.conversation.juan_playground.thanks.text: Thanks for listening. Maybe we can find a solution together.
strings.conversation.juan_playground.later.text: Okay. I would still like to play with you.
strings.enemy.knotted_shadow.name: Knotted Shadow
strings.enemy.knotted_shadow.description: A small knot of shadow is trying to block the path to the playground.
strings.encounter.playground_shadow.name: The Shadow at the Playground
strings.encounter.playground_shadow.victory: Together, the children untie the shadow knot and clear the path.
strings.encounter.playground_shadow.defeat: The children move together to a safe place and can try again later.
